description: Mediation Board Commission - Mediation Boards Commission calling for Nominations for the Appointment of mediators
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the appointment of judicial/legal officers (mediators and chairmen for Mediation Boards) under the Mediation Boards Act. It involves a call for nominations for these quasi-judicial positions, outlines eligibility criteria, and specifies the appointment process. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it deals with the administration of alternative dispute resolution mechanisms within the legal system.
